comment: The toolchains of crudui that no other file declares. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (Go, uv and Python, alint for make layout-check, ruff and vulture for make lint-python, golangci-lint and deadcode for make lint-go, cargo-audit for make dependency-review, and Composer, which installs PHPCS and PHPStan of config/php-lint for make lint-php) and mise.lock locks them. PHP is verified at the declared release.
